h1: De Botan Srinakarin Bangkok — Rooftop Pool 3-Star in Bangkok's Eastern Suburbs, Near Seacon Square
intro: Srinakarin Road has a quietly compelling character that Bangkok insiders appreciate: Seacon Square — a vast mall with a water park and ice rink — anchors one end, while Suan Luang Rama 9 Park (the city's largest public green space), the buzzing Train Night Market, and quick expressway access to Suvarnabhumi Airport round out the appeal. De Botan Srinakarin Hotel & Residence, tucked into Soi Supapong 3 in Prawet District, offers 46 rooms with a rooftop pool, gym, restaurant, and free parking — at a price point that is genuinely competitive for Bangkok. Rates run from approximately ฿900 to ฿1,500/night. The composite review score is 8.1 from 428 ratings on Booking.com, with the staff score at an impressive 8.8.

body.html: De Botan Srinakarin Hotel & Residence sits on Soi Supapong 3, a short turn off Srinakarin Road in the Prawet district of east Bangkok. The address is not one that appears in standard tourist itineraries, but that is precisely part of its charm — this is where Bangkok residents actually live, shop at Seacon Square, and spend weekends at Suan Luang Rama 9 Park. Paradise Park, Paseo, and Thanya Park are all within a short drive, giving guests a range of dining and leisure options without venturing into the traffic-heavy centre.

The 46 rooms span three categories: Standard Room (28 sqm) with king or twin beds; Deluxe Room (31 sqm), refurbished with city views and a king bed; and Junior Suite (41 sqm), which adds a large work desk and extra floor space suitable for extended business stays. All rooms include air-conditioning, LED TV, free Wi-Fi, a safety deposit box, and a private bathroom with complimentary toiletries. Select rooms have private balconies with views over the Prawet district.

"Staff at the front desk were incredibly helpful — they arranged a Grab, recommended a nearby restaurant, and made check-in effortless. The only small issue was some corridor noise at night, but the value for money here is hard to beat."

What genuinely sets De Botan apart from most 3-star hotels in this price bracket is its rooftop outdoor pool, open 7 am to 9 pm and offering panoramic city views. Guest reviews mention the pool consistently and positively, often with the phrase "better than expected for a 3-star." The gym is compact but equipped for light training sessions. The hotel restaurant serves an American-Asian breakfast from 7 am to 10 am at an additional charge of approximately ฿189 per person — a reasonable add-on if you prefer not to venture out first thing.

For transport, the nearest station is MRT Yellow Line Suan Luang Rama 9 (YL15), about 1.5 km from the hotel — roughly a 10-minute Grab ride. From there, change to the Blue Line at Lat Phrao for connections across central Bangkok. By car, Srinakarin Road feeds directly onto the expressway, placing Suvarnabhumi Airport approximately 20–25 minutes away outside rush hour. Free on-site parking makes the hotel particularly practical for guests arriving by their own vehicle — a meaningful perk in this suburban district where most people drive.

The staff score of 8.8 on Booking.com is the hotel's most consistent talking point across all review platforms. Guests describe front-desk staff as polite, proactive, and communicative in English. Cleanliness scores sit at 8.5 on Booking.com and 8.7 on Trip.com, indicating that housekeeping standards hold up reliably over time. The value-for-money score of 8.5 reinforces the sense that the room rate punches well above its weight when factored against the rooftop pool and the staff service level on offer.

There are genuine trade-offs to acknowledge. The location is not suited to guests planning daily sorties into the Sukhumvit or Siam shopping districts — expect 45 to 60 minutes each way during peak hours. Some reviews note noise from adjacent rooms and street traffic, particularly on lower floors near the road. A handful of guests describe beds as firmer than comfortable, and English-language TV channel choices are limited. The overall score of 8.1 reflects solid satisfaction for what the property offers, not a claim to five-star refinement.

highlights.title: Rooftop Pool with City Views
highlights.text: An outdoor pool on the top floor with 360-degree views over Prawet — rare at this price point, and consistently praised by guests as exceeding expectations for a 3-star property.

highlights.text: Srinakarin expressway runs direct to Suvarnabhumi Airport in around 20 minutes, and free on-site parking removes the cost and hassle of leaving a car in the city.

honestSummary: De Botan Srinakarin delivers more than the price suggests — a rooftop pool that guests genuinely enjoy, staff consistently praised across platforms, and free parking in a city where that counts. It is a smart base for east Bangkok and Suvarnabhumi trips. The trade-offs are real: noise sensitivity may be an issue and the distance from central Bangkok demands planning.
honestChecks: If your itinerary centres on Sukhumvit, Siam, or Chinatown sightseeing every day — the 45-to-60-minute commute from Srinakarin during peak hours can stack up quickly. Factor in Grab costs against the room saving before deciding.

If you are a light sleeper — request a room on a higher floor, away from the street side, at check-in. Some reviews flag noise from both the road and corridor traffic, which is worth managing proactively.

If room aesthetics matter to you — a handful of guests noted that the room condition was not entirely consistent with photos on booking platforms. Checking photos uploaded by recent guests on Booking.com or Agoda before reserving will set expectations accurately.

tips.title: Head to the Rooftop Pool at Dusk
tips.body: The rooftop pool is at its most atmospheric between 5 pm and 7 pm, when the Prawet skyline catches the golden hour light. Guests recommend going up before dinner rather than in the midday heat.

tips.title: Driving? Park Free and Leave for the Airport Early
tips.body: Free parking removes one of Bangkok's usual hotel headaches. For early-morning flights from Suvarnabhumi, allow 40 minutes from the hotel to clear security — the expressway is fast outside rush hour but can slow during morning peaks.

tips.title: Seacon Square and the Train Night Market Are Close
tips.body: Seacon Square is about a 5-minute drive — a sprawling mall with a food court, cinema, supermarket, water park, and ice rink. The Train Night Market (open evenings) is another 10 minutes by car, ideal for a street-food evening out.

tips.title: MRT Yellow Line — How to Use It
tips.body: Suan Luang Rama 9 station (YL15) is about 10 minutes by Grab from the hotel. Transfer to the MRT Blue Line at Lat Phrao for Sukhumvit, Silom, or Chatuchak. Useful for day trips — not ideal for daily commuting from this base.

faqTitle: Frequently Asked Questions — De Botan Srinakarin Hotel Bangkok

faq.q: Where is De Botan Srinakarin Hotel located in Bangkok?
faq.a: The hotel is at 12 Soi Supapong 3, Srinakarin Road, Nong Bon, Prawet, Bangkok 10250. It is about a 5-minute drive from Seacon Square, 7 minutes from Suan Luang Rama 9 Park, 10 minutes from the Train Night Market Srinakarin, and approximately 20–25 minutes by car from Suvarnabhumi Airport.

faq.q: What are the room types and prices at De Botan Srinakarin?
faq.a: Rates start from approximately ฿900/night for a Standard Room (28 sqm). Deluxe Room (31 sqm) runs around ฿1,100 and the Junior Suite (41 sqm) around ฿1,500. Prices vary by season and platform — compare across Agoda, Booking.com, and Trip.com for the best rate.

faq.q: Does De Botan Srinakarin have a swimming pool?
faq.a: Yes — a rooftop outdoor pool is open to guests daily from 07:00 to 21:00. It offers panoramic city views and is one of the hotel's most consistently praised features in guest reviews, often described as "better than expected for a 3-star property."

faq.q: How do you get from De Botan Srinakarin to central Bangkok?
faq.a: The closest station is MRT Yellow Line Suan Luang Rama 9 (YL15), about 1.5 km from the hotel (around 10 minutes by Grab). Transfer to the MRT Blue Line at Lat Phrao for Sukhumvit, Silom, or Chatuchak. By car, the expressway gives quick access to Suvarnabhumi Airport in around 20 minutes.

faq.q: Who is De Botan Srinakarin best suited for?
faq.a: Best suited for travellers arriving or departing via Suvarnabhumi Airport, east Bangkok business visitors, families wanting a suburban base near Seacon Square, and car-travelling guests who value free parking. Less ideal for those planning daily excursions to Sukhumvit or other central Bangkok attractions.
